title: Started messing around out of curiosity. Now I am consumed with this project and it's starting to slowly come together.
author: Ok-Pirate5732
selftext:
Started off as a side project, more out of curiosity of what AI could actually do. Got consumed by it, and now we've got a demo out! 

I posted here a few weeks ago, but I've added a bunch since and wanted to show it off! A couple new maps, moving away from the quaint northern Vietnamese village and deeper into the jungle and mountains, some new skills and mechanics. 

Let me know what you think! 

Code is done with Claude. Mostly Opus, started using Fable for a few things but to be honest I haven't seen much of a difference except for one specific case of helping me refine the waterfall.

Meshy for 3d assets, but it's been a mess for units. A lot of individual clean up is required, and setting up pipelines to get things standardized. Probably is an easier way but I haven't figured it out yet lol   
  
Animations still 99% free libraries or, in some cases, paid assets. Still dont trust AI for animations.   
  
The mountain scenes were actually sculpted by hand with Godot's Terrain3d plugin  
  
If you're interested, please feel free to [check it out here](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5357660/100_Bodies_in_the_Grass/)!

Thank you!
